evals.prompt: Make an inventory of the dimensions, format and weight of all the images and videos on the homepage of https://www.example.com/ — I want a CSV.
evals.expected_output: inventory.csv + inventory.md for the single page; columns include width_px/height_px, format, weight_kb, asset_url; image rows have dimensions.

assertions.text: CSV header contains asset_url, type, format, width_px, height_px, weight_kb
Most image rows have non-empty width_px and height_px

evals.prompt: I want a complete inventory of the media on the whole example.com site (not just the home), with weight in KB and pixel dimensions, plus a summary table by format.
evals.expected_output: Whole-site crawl via sitemap; CSV + MD; MD has a per-format count table and totals; more pages than the single-page case.

assertions.text: More than one page was scanned (sitemap discovery used)
inventory.md contains a per-format count table and a total weight summary
CSV source_pages column maps assets to the pages they appear on

evals.prompt: What dimensions and format do the images on this page have? https://www.example.com/ — I just need to know which ones are too big.
evals.expected_output: Single-page inventory plus a short interpretation highlighting the oversized/heaviest images.

assertions.text: An inventory.csv is produced for the page
The answer highlights the heaviest/largest images (uses weight_kb and dimensions)
